metric_limits: CER ignores whitespace, punctuation and common LaTeX wrappers. It is a diagnostic, not a formula-semantic or full layout score. Synthetic reference text includes text within drawn figures. Full quality non-regression needs visual review and additional annotations.

annotated_quality.limits: Cells use NFKC, case folding and whitespace normalization while retaining punctuation. Equations compare exact operator-preserving token transcriptions after supported LaTeX presentation normalization; matches do not establish semantic equivalence. Unsupported notation is a mismatch.
